raw_response:
This plot is very small, only a few steps across, so buying a whole bag of chemical fertilizer would be too much money and too much for this land anyway. I will spread cow manure that I have collected from my animals, and I will plant the maize seed I kept from last year's harvest because I know it grows here. My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting and weeding, but I will hire a neighbor with oxen for one day to plough this piece because I am too old to break the soil myself.
